summary: Added three ECS rules, since the spec didn't name them: E3052 (Fargate task definitions must use awsvpc NetworkMode), E3053 (Fargate task definitions with awslogs containers must have ExecutionRoleArn), and E3054 (Fargate services must have NetworkConfiguration). Each is a JSON-schema rule with a schema file, a rule class in src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/, and unit tests; docs/rules.md has rows for them. All 65 ECS tests pass. The full suite has 5 failures, all environmental (missing defusedxml, junit_xml, pydot/pygraphviz, and quickstart tests that call the base-installed cfn-lint binary). Nothing is committed. No good/bad fixture templates or snapshots were added for the new rules. Please confirm the rule choice.
